explanation: In Donkey Kong (1981) he was a carpenter called Jumpman, climbing girders to rescue a woman from a giant ape. He became a plumber in Mario Bros. in 1983.

claims.text: In Donkey Kong (1981), the first game Mario appeared in, he was a carpenter, not a plumber.
In Donkey Kong the character was called Jumpman.
Mario was first presented as a plumber in Mario Bros. in 1983.
